name: Claude Code
description: Connect your local Claude Code agent.
destination: Merge the openslot entry into your private .mcp.json.

name: Claude app
destination: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Sign in with OpenSlot.

name: Google Antigravity
destination: Merge into your Antigravity mcp_config.json using Manage MCP servers → View raw config.

name: Cursor
destination: Merge into your private ~/.cursor/mcp.json, then refresh MCP servers.

name: Gemini CLI
destination: Merge into ~/.gemini/settings.json, then restart Gemini CLI.

name: VS Code / Copilot
description: Scheduling tools in VS Code agent mode.
destination: Merge into your user MCP configuration using MCP: Open User Configuration.

name: OpenAI API
description: Remote MCP tools through the Responses API.
destination: Install openai. Set OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_MODEL and OPENSLOT_API_KEY in your agent environment.

name: Anthropic API
description: Claude Messages API with remote MCP tools.
destination: Install anthropic. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODEL and OPENSLOT_API_KEY in your agent environment.

name: Amazon Bedrock
description: Attach OpenSlot to an existing AgentCore harness.
destination: Add this entry to your AgentCore harness tools array. AWS credentials and model selection stay in your harness.

name: GLM / Z.ai
destination: Install openai. Set ZAI_API_KEY, ZAI_MODEL and OPENSLOT_API_KEY in your agent environment.

name: Grok / xAI
description: Remote MCP tools through xAI Responses.
destination: Install openai. Set XAI_API_KEY, XAI_MODEL and OPENSLOT_API_KEY in your agent environment.

name: Other MCP client
description: Standard HTTP MCP settings for your own agent.
destination: Adapt this entry to your client's remote HTTP MCP configuration.
